title: Dodge
text: Left Shift dodges. With no direction held it is a backstep. Hold it after the dodge to flow into a dash.

title: Dash on
text: Hold the dodge button after dodging while you hold a direction, and the dodge turns into a dash. Release, stop or jump to end it.

title: Dodge attack
text: Press attack right after the locked part of a dodge to start the dash attack.

title: Guard and deflect
text: A guard pressed just before a hit deflects it. Deflecting costs you almost no posture and hurts the attacker's.

title: Do not mash guard
text: Tapping guard again and again shrinks your deflect window. Press once, on purpose, and the window comes back after a moment.

title: Posture
text: Posture fills when you guard or get hit. Full posture means a break, and a broken enemy can be finished with a deathblow.

title: Deathblow
text: When an enemy's posture breaks or its health bar is empty, attack near it to land a deathblow.

title: Posture recovery
text: Posture recovers on its own after a second, but not while you are acting. Holding guard for a few seconds makes it recover twice as fast.

title: Danger symbol
text: A red symbol over your head means a perilous attack is coming. It cannot be guarded, and only a deflect pressed at the last moment works on a thrust.

title: Against a thrust
text: Dodge toward a perilous thrust at the right moment to counter it. The enemy is cut short and loses posture.

title: Against a sweep
text: Jump over a perilous sweep. If you land on the enemy's head, it is stunned.

title: Against a grab
text: A yellow symbol means a grab. Guarding does nothing against it: dodge.

title: Healing
text: Q drinks from the gourd. It takes about a second at walking speed, and a hit interrupts it. A charge is spent only when the drink finishes.

title: Cancel a heal
text: Dodge, jump, attack or guard cancels a heal for free, so you can back out when it goes wrong.

title: Resurrection
text: You can resurrect twice per run. At the prompt, attack resurrects you and guard lets you die.

title: Lock-on
text: Middle mouse locks onto the enemy nearest the center of the screen. Press again to release, and flick the mouse to switch targets.

title: Combo
text: Attacks chain into a five-hit combo that loops. Hold attack at the end of a wind-up to charge a thrust.

title: Sheathe
text: R sheathes the sword, and it sheathes itself after about five calm seconds. Attacking while sheathed is a fast draw slash.

title: Charged draw
text: Hold attack while the sword is sheathed to charge a stronger draw slash.

title: Crouch
text: Left Ctrl toggles crouching. Your body is smaller, so some high attacks pass over you.

title: Slide
text: Press crouch while dashing to slide. The slide has a short moment of invulnerability, like a dodge.

title: Wall jump
text: Jump in the air next to a wall to kick off it. You get two wall jumps per airtime.

title: Ledges
text: Reach a ledge while holding E to hang from it. Then E climbs, crouch drops, jump leaps away, and left or right shimmies along it.

title: Helm splitter
text: Hold attack in the air for a diving strike. It also works while the sword is sheathed.

title: Head bounce
text: Landing on an enemy's head while falling bounces you up. Any other landing on a head slides you off.

title: Pausing
text: Esc, or Start on a pad, pauses the game. Nothing moves while the menu is open.

title: Falling
text: Falling out of the world costs a quarter of your maximum health, but never your last point, and puts you back at the start.

title: Hit streaks
text: Enemies that get hit several times in a row start guarding harder. Vary your timing instead of repeating one string.

title: Still a prototype
text: Numbers and animations here are placeholders. If something feels off, it probably is a number somebody has not tuned yet.

title: Breathe
text: You lose nothing by backing off. Let your posture recover, then go back in.

title: The squad
text: With several enemies, lock onto one and keep moving. Your guard only covers what is in front of you.

title: Repulsers
text: A repulser can bounce your attack back and cut your swing short. Deflect, dodge or wait it out.

title: Monks
text: Monks lean on perilous thrusts and sweeps. Watch for the red symbol before you commit to a combo.

title: Grapplers
text: A grappler tries to grab you. Keep your finger on dodge when it gets close.

title: Duelists
text: Duelists pressure you with thrusts. Practice your dodge direction here.

title: Bosses
text: When a boss notices you, its name, health and posture move to the screen edge.

title: Training Yard
text: The Training Yard has one station for every move. Try each one a few times before the Gauntlet.

title: Gauntlet
text: The Gauntlet chains the moves over a void. A fall sends you back to the start pad.

title: Low tunnels
text: A low tunnel needs a crouch or a slide. Crouch is a toggle, so you can stay down while you walk.

title: Long gaps
text: The last gap is wider than a plain jump. A dash jump is the way across.

title: Test arena
text: The test arena is a jumble of platforms, walls and a gap, for trying out the movement.
